GitHub Advisory API https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-9hvg-qw5q-wqwp has withdrawn_at=null, type=reviewed, and the vendor advisory reproducer http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin/reporting/products/view?type={{7*7}}.

Source-to-sink at the pre-fix parent 43fdebc2468323e715f71045fcc29c7d693beb70: packages/Webkul/Admin/src/Routes/reporting-routes.php (and the same file at 71b8aa0a2280294a383cbbd834045f94c9d8c5f3) mounts ProductController::view on GET reporting/products/view behind middleware ['admin']. ProductController::view() at c231584802de4c73ad54cd7e15bd916a8e3ba09d renders admin::reporting.view with entity=products and does not allowlist request()->query('type'). packages/Webkul/Admin/src/Resources/views/reporting/view.blade.php concatenates that query value into @lang('admin::app.reporting.' . $entity . '.index.' . request()->query('type')) both in the page title and inside <script type="text/x-template" id="v-reporting-stats-table-template">. A missing translation returns the key, so attacker-controlled {{...}} survives into the Vue runtime-compiled template (the advertised {{7*7}} PoC).
Vendor release https://github.com/bagisto/bagisto/releases/tag/v2.3.10 states that type-parameter handling is now validated to prevent SSTI.

findings: CVE-2026-21450 / GHSA-9hvg-qw5q-wqwp is a real, non-withdrawn template-injection bug: an admin-authenticated type query parameter is concatenated into a Blade @lang() expression that is emitted inside a Vue text/x-template and compiled client-side.

Atomic BIC is 71b8aa0a2280294a383cbbd834045f94c9d8c5f3 ('Export feature added'), whose patch first writes request()->query('type') into the Vue x-template heading; immediate parent 75a47568006720d3b7b153181b269d56edae0aec still has the static @lang('admin::app.reporting.sales.index.title') at that location (blobs e16572dfe30cb8cbb1fb44162edccde97b7d28f1 vs 64deb23266256a33edd8fdc53564b332c2f050ce).
65f2beb6273d2e98f3a3ca68a884212903a71caa introduced unvalidated type into the title slot and JS params but not into the compiled Vue template; it is not the BIC for the advertised {{7*7}} sink.

Direct fix is b1b276a34bc8413bb64fabcb7fb35f2b36144864 (allowlist abort in view()); advisory fix 3f294b4837595929107d9c1bbd6d5b1222ef9fea centralizes that allowlist. v2.3.9 contains the BIC without either fix; v2.3.10 contains both.
BIC author/committer is the named human Jitendra <jitendra@webkul.in> / jitendra-webkul with no AI/bot/generator/co-author marker on the BIC object, so NOT_AI stands.
